name: Source Map Symbolicator
description: Import the Source Map shipped with your build and batch-map minified error positions back to source files, lines, columns and symbol names. Supports Chrome/V8 and Firefox stacks
help: Open or paste a .map file, then paste the error stack to symbolicate. The asset association defaults to the map's file field and can be overridden manually; files are never matched by name guessing.
Output lines and columns are 1-based (matching the browser); generated columns use UTF-16 code units, so lines with emoji still line up.
Both regular mappings and index maps with sections are supported; external section URLs are never fetched. Missing mappings, broken VLQ and out-of-range indexes all report a clear reason.
Source code only comes from embedded sourcesContent — no URLs are fetched and no script is executed. Mapping and stack limits apply, and large files can be cancelled while parsing.
